capabilities: Deliver notes from the ReelLeaf cloud inbox into the vault automatically
Write notes to dated folders with verified, non-overwriting attachment handling
Bind and unbind the plugin using a one-time code from WeChat
Trigger a manual cloud-inbox sync from the command palette
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The plugin is desktop-only, communicates only with api.reelleaf.huggzer.cn, and paid plans unlock higher quotas beyond the free trial. A Chinese-language description is included.
problem: Saving public web pages, images, and videos shared in WeChat into Obsidian requires manual copying and reformatting, which the service handles by extracting, OCR-ing, and transcribing content.

requires.name: WeChat (mini program or official account for binding and sending content)
ReelLeaf paid plans for higher quotas

summary: Client for the ReelLeaf capture service that delivers web pages, images, and videos sent via WeChat into the vault as Markdown notes.
